what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Benin, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 26415 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 27294 internally displaced people of concern to it.
Few people from Benin are refugees abroad; the largest number live in France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Benin with JNIM from 2022 to 2025.
Storms are the disasters recorded for Benin in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 3494 in 2018 to the 2025 figure.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
